versions.content: If development error detection is enabled by MirrorDevEr- rorDetect , the Bus Mirroring module shall check the NetworkHandleType pa- rameters of its service functions against the ComMChannelId referenced via Mir- rorComMNetworkHandleRef , and shall report the development error MIRROR_E_- INVALID_NETWORK_ID when an unknown network handle is provided by the call.
